_note: Official routes shown under 'Official routes that may apply', by topic: "traffic" for answers from the traffic Acts (rta, rtr, rter, rtsn), "general" for every answer. Fixed text: never generated by the model. Describe what each route is and its conditions only. Never say what the user should do, never say anyone is entitled or in breach, never give odds. Last checked against official sources: November 2026.

traffic.name: Singapore Police Force: Traffic Police e-services
traffic.what: Official service to check outstanding traffic offences and pay traffic fines.
traffic.eligibility: Log in with Singpass, or use a foreign vehicle number.
traffic.limits: Shows only offences issued by the Traffic Police. Cases still under investigation are not shown. Payment is only through the e-service or AXS.

general.name: Pro Bono SG (formerly Law Society Pro Bono Services)
general.what: Runs community legal clinics that give free basic legal information and advice.
general.eligibility: Means-tested, for people with limited means. Mainly Singapore citizens and permanent residents.
general.limits: Basic advice at a clinic; it does not always include a lawyer acting for you. Current criteria are on the site.
